children: According to CNBC, Megaspeed said Alice Huang left the company effective Aug. 30, 2025, and that it had launched an internal probe into media reports about its business, supply chain and global operations. The Singapore-based cloud computing company said the reports were not supported by verifiable evidence and that it had retained external legal counsel to conduct the investigation. Megaspeed said it would review the reporting and communicate with stakeholders as appropriate.

title: Megaspeed Says Alice Huang Left in 2025 as It Launches Internal Probe Into Business Reports
